decode: ffmpeg -v error -i source/holdin-on-meme-source.mp3 -ar 22050 -ac 1 -f s16le pipe:1; freeze output as mono16-bit22050Hz WAV using Python wave
derivation: Use frozen decoded PCM. Multiply by10**(-7/20), fade in over8ms, fade out from14.9 to15.25seconds, round to signed16-bit integers, duplicate mono into both stereo channels, pad with silence to20seconds. No time stretching, looping, synthesized substitute, or full-track distribution.
generator: generate.py --audio-only reconstructs audio and archive from frozen local sources; no network required
waveform: Two channel peak envelopes computed directly from the same WAV PCM used by playback and meters, over the full20-second timeline
limits: Human listening and independent acoustic fingerprinting have not been performed
The source is a short mono soundboard excerpt, not an archival stereo master
Old validation reports concern earlier revisions; soundtrack-review.json is the focused replacement validation
